summary: Tested both new features from this session: (1) Cleaner Radar declutter on RadarView/AdaptiveRadarPillMarker, (2) Orrbbit Verified Meetup Spots section on /meetup-point + new backend endpoint GET /api/business/meetup-spots. Ran 11 new backend pytest cases (all passing) plus full Playwright regression across Radar, Meetup Spots flow (select/continue/safety-confirm), fallback tiles, Today/Nearby/Encounters/Profile tabs, and both demo logins (Explore Demo + Try Business Demo). No console errors, no red screens, all critical flows work as specified.

issues: Seeded venue images (picsum.photos random stock photos) are thematically mismatched: 'The Daily Grind' (Café) shows a castle photo, 'The Commons' (Coworking Space) shows a pier/beach photo, 'Riverside Community Center' shows an ocean photo. Not broken/404 but not relevant to the venue category — cosmetic only, low priority.

verified_working: Radar: 4 individual avatars + 4 cluster pills = 8 people-related markers (within 6-8 target), focus chip reads 'X nearby · Showing your best 4' (was 'best 12')
Radar: cluster pills render single-line readable labels (Advice/Networking/Chat/Coffee) with count badge, color-coded, no overlap
Radar: business event pin ('Live Jazz on the Wharf') keeps full label pill (name+BUSINESS+status+distance); tapping opens correct event preview
Radar: non-business event pins render icon-only (no text label) but are still tappable via radar-event-<id> testID and open correct event details (verified with 'Coffee & Co-work Catch-up')

Radar: radius/events/filters chips, privacy pill + Learn more, bottom stats card, vibe selector, visibility toggle, bottom nav (Today|Radar|Nearby|Encounters|Profile) all present/unchanged, zoom/recentre controls present
Meetup Spots: 'Meet at an Orrbbit Verified Spot' section renders with correct subtext and info icon; tapping info icon shows correct alert text via window.alert
Meetup Spots: exactly 3 seeded cards render with correct names/categories/distances (315m/459m/697m matching spec) + green verified badge + chevron
Meetup Spots: tapping a spot card selects it (teal border, checkmark icon), enables Continue, navigates to /safety-confirm showing 'Meetup point: The Daily Grind (Café)'
Meetup Spots: selecting a fallback tile (e.g. Cafe) after a verified spot was selected correctly deselects the verified spot and safety-confirm shows plain 'Meetup point: Cafe'
Meetup Spots: all 10 original fallback testIDs present and unaffected; safety message and back button (meetup-point-back) work

Backend: GET /api/business/meetup-spots returns 200, correct shape, sorted ascending by distance, excludes 'The Wharf Kitchen' (Verified but not meetup_spot_approved), requires auth (401/403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/business/nearby (prior session) still works, 200, correct shape, requires auth
Regression: Today dashboard, Nearby, Encounters, Profile tabs navigate cleanly with zero console errors; Explore Demo and Try Business Demo logins both work end to end
action_items: Optional/cosmetic: consider swapping picsum.photos seed images for DEMO_MEETUP_SPOTS to more category-appropriate images (café/coworking/community center) for visual polish — not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: business.py meetup-spots endpoint correctly separates meetup_spot_approved flag from general verification_status — good design matching the 'not every verified business qualifies' intent.
server.py seed_demo_meetup_spots() is idempotent (replace_one upsert on slug), safe to call on every startup/demo-reset as required.
RadarView.tsx MAX_CLUSTERS=4 and FOCUS_MARKERS=4 correctly bound total markers to <=8, matching the reference declutter goal.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing seeded demo data (DEMO_MEETUP_SPOTS, demo users, Wharf Kitchen business).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both features (Cleaner Radar + Orrbbit Verified Meetup Spots) are fully working end-to-end, backend and frontend. Only a minor cosmetic note about mismatched stock images for the 3 seeded verified venues. No regressions found in Today/Nearby/Encounters/Profile/business demo. Backend test file test_iter_meetup_spots_radar.py can be reused for future regression runs (needs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var).
